answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a raven bet on surviving 105 epochs of grading, and every whisper settlement recomputes the nectar schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 105 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
